program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const g = 9.8; const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const t = time; const h = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const v = u - g * t; const apexTime = u / g; const apexHeight = (u * u) / (2 * g); const pixelsPerMeter = 60; const baseY = 320; const ballY = baseY - h * pixelsPerMeter; const ballX = 320; const motionState = t < apexTime ? "Moving up" : (Math.abs(v) < 0.05 ? "Still for an instant" : "Moving down"); const gravityState = "Gravity pulls down"; const objects = [ ...sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "Toss", state: motionState }), sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 120, y: 320, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.5, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5], label: "Height", unit: "m" }), sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28), sdk.groundMark("mark.launch", ballX, baseY, 60, "Launch"), ...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX, y: ballY }, { value: v, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" }), ...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX + 35, y: ballY }, { value: -g, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "a" }), sdk.callout(ballX + 70, ballY - 30, [motionState, gravityState], { id: "callout.toss" }) ]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionState }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: v, height: h } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls downward.
manifest.description: A vertical height scale shows a tennis ball tossed upward. A blue arrow indicates velocity, shortening as the ball rises and pointing downward as it falls. A dashed gravity arrow remains constant throughout.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
